resources.string: Balanced keeps the normal launcher behaviour. Ultra-Lite reduces background work and caching on 3–4 GB devices.
Total RAM: %1$s · Available: %2$s · Android %3$s (API %4$d) · %5$s · %6$d cores · %7$d Java runtimes\nSuggested: %8$s\nTap to apply the suggested profile.
These switches apply in the Custom profile. Ultra-Lite enables the first three automatically.
Skip the mod icon cache scan when the launcher starts. The scan still runs when browsing mods.
Keep at most 16 MB of cached mod icons and use one loader thread.
Refresh download progress four times a second instead of ten.
Skips the logcat reader while the game runs. latestlog.txt then contains only launcher messages. Use only if game logs are not needed.
Sets the memory allocation to a conservative value for this device. Custom Java arguments are never changed.
Recommended heap: %1$d MB. Restart the game for it to take effect.
